chunks: Allah is sufficient, and sufficient is His Messenger.
And sufficient is death as a reminder.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the hadith 'Kafa billahi wa kafa bi-rasulihi'?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights this hadith to reinforce the concept of *Husn al-Zann* (good expectation) in Allah, asserting that divine sufficiency (*Kafa'ah*) provides believers with spiritual resilience against worldly trials. The mention of death serves as a practical reminder of *Barzakh*, urging the faithful to maintain steadfastness in faith until the inevitable return to the Creator.
